candidate_id_note: Items 8-12 were numbered findings rather than explicit IDs in the clean worker; comparator-local IDs preserve the worker numbering and source blob without altering worker state.

assessments.mechanism: Subgoal-local detailed context with folded representations of completed subgoals.
assessments.clean_scope: HIPIF 2026 agent benchmarks. Qwen2.5-3B full ALFWorld/VirtualHome/ScienceWorld 96.1/63.3/64.8 versus w/o Subgoal 73.9/46.9/43.1; ALFWorld steps/tokens 16.5/16.6k versus 38.0/37.8k without subgoal.
assessments.uncertainty: Transfer outside tested environments/models and exact attribution among folding/subgoal/reward/reflection remain bounded.
assessments.o_comparison: O Context Kernel materializes bounded projections and routes optional context without copy-all, but does not implement HIPIF completed-subgoal folding or its ablations.

assessments.mechanism: Selective proactive memory intervention: choose targeted reminders or silence/no-op instead of always exposing memory.
assessments.clean_scope: 2026 Terminal-Bench/tau2-Bench. Sonnet 4.5 Terminal-Bench 37.6→45.9 (+8.3pp); tau2 weighted 55.0→61.8 (+6.8pp). Always exposing full bank underperforms selective memory in reported tau2 Sonnet ablation; untrained helper can hurt.
assessments.uncertainty: Effects are model/task dependent and memory-agent training matters.
assessments.o_comparison: O supports situation-dependent optional context and rejects eager all-context, but has no separate proactive reminder/no-op agent or matched benchmark result.

assessments.mechanism: More allowed steps can worsen long-horizon performance through context locking; context refresh/reset is a candidate mitigation.
assessments.clean_scope: UltraHorizon 2025. GLM-4.5 Mystery Grid normalized score falls 34.4→14.1→9.37→7.03→5.62 as hidden rules 1→5 while calls rise; Qwen3-235B Sequence Exploration drops 6.44pp without step cap; one GLM setting peaks ~125 steps then declines at 150.
assessments.uncertainty: No trustworthy numeric CRNR benefit is yet extracted; step-scaling failure is environment/model specific.
assessments.o_comparison: O treats budget exhaustion as resumable, uses fresh logical boundaries and rejects indiscriminate context accumulation, but has no UltraHorizon/CRNR measurement.

assessments.mechanism: Inherited long trajectories can transmit goal drift even when a model can state the correct current goal.
assessments.clean_scope: ICLR 2026 lifelong-agent stock-trading/ER-triage experiments; at 16-step conditioning only GPT-5.1 and Gemini-2.5-Flash-thinking consistently recovered to zero drift within 10 steps in the reported setup, and at 32 steps GPT-5.1 alone did so consistently.
assessments.o_comparison: O makes terminal objective/user authority mandatory and uses source freshness/invalidation/logical resets, but has no inherited-goal-drift behavioral benchmark.

assessments.mechanism: Reduce effective decision horizon through policy-controlled macro-actions/subgoal decomposition and horizon-aware curriculum during training.
assessments.clean_scope: ICML 2026. Sudoku pass@4 at test horizons 11-15 through 41-45: macro-action RL 99/100/98/91/85/61/38 versus atomic RL 98/79/58/27/11/0/0; fixed task families/action granularities.
assessments.uncertainty: Transfer from training-time macro-action RL to O's non-RL work units is untested.
assessments.o_comparison: O decomposes work into units but does not train policies with macro-actions/horizon curricula or compare atomic-vs-macro RL.

assessments.mechanism: Long-run collapse is not simply context-window exhaustion; larger context alone is not a sufficient remedy.
assessments.clean_scope: Vending-Bench 2025 long-running business simulation; some runs exceed 20M tokens and paper reports no clear correlation between failure and context-fill point.
assessments.uncertainty: Absence of simple fill correlation does not isolate one causal failure mechanism.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly rejects copy-all raw context and treats selection/freshness/conditioning as structural; it has not reproduced Vending-Bench.

assessments.mechanism: Branch-and-fold completed subtrajectories to keep active context small while preserving relevant state.
assessments.clean_scope: Context-Folding 2025 reports active context up to 10x smaller with matched/outperforming ReAct on reported research/SWE-style tasks; full task-by-task numeric deltas were not extracted by the clean worker.
assessments.uncertainty: Exact per-task gains and transfer are unresolved.
assessments.o_comparison: O already selects optional context branches and freezes compact projections, but does not implement branch/fold trajectory operations or FoldGRPO.

assessments.mechanism: Evaluate and maintain active memory as online state update/revision/interference handling, not passive retrieval alone.
assessments.clean_scope: GAMBIT 2026 deterministic game episodes. Llama 3.1 8B NIAH=1.000 yet aggregate GAMBIT=0.304; GPT-5.5 GAMBIT=0.447 versus Gemini 3.1 Pro=0.481. Error decomposition is predominantly cognitive (e.g. N-back 94%, stale-state dominant); GAMBIT correlates with instruction-update accuracy rho=0.65, p=0.006 but not static grounding rho=0.04, p=0.908.
assessments.uncertainty: Benchmark covers five main task families and does not itself prove one active-memory architecture.
assessments.o_comparison: O implements authoritative source clocks, updates, contradictions and invalidation, so an active-state submechanism exists, but no GAMBIT-style behavioral measurement of stale-state/interference/binding is recorded.

assessments.mechanism: Recover from stuck trajectories by restoring aligned agent context and reversible environment state, while injecting a compact lesson from the failed path.
assessments.clean_scope: AgentRewind submitted 2026-08-14, MettleBench 82 engineering tasks/640 criteria. Worker flags exact table values 62.2/78.0/87.8 task success and component 43.9/65.9/51.2 as indexed-rendering values needing primary-table re-verification. External/network/process effects outside controlled workspace are explicitly not rewound.
assessments.uncertainty: Exact table values are not yet primary-verified by the clean worker; reversibility is bounded to controlled state.
assessments.o_comparison: O has checkpointed continuation, fenced recovery, immutable replay/idempotency and safe logical reset, but does not restore a coupled external environment/context checkpoint or retain a rewind-specific failed-path lesson.

assessments.mechanism: Use typed memory-to-action provenance dependencies to invalidate unsupported descendants and selectively replay only affected computation while preserving independently supported state.
assessments.clean_scope: 2026-08-11 preprint. Controlled 150-case benchmark: 85.3% recovery versus 77.3% best competing method; LongMemEval-V2-derived 50-case stress test 68.0% versus 54.0%; claim invalidation F1 0.669 versus 0.603.
assessments.uncertainty: Paper does not claim uniformly better trace reconstruction; transfer beyond tested memory failures/tool-use domains remains open.
assessments.o_comparison: O already tracks source dependencies/provenance/invalidation and immutable replay, so related submechanisms exist, but no descendant invalidation plus selective answer-relevant recomputation experiment is implemented.

assessments.mechanism: An intervention that fixes a diagnosed long-horizon bottleneck can reverse across model generations; judge final task effect rather than only proxy/checkpoint improvement.
assessments.clean_scope: 2026-08-20 security-agent study, pre-specified 92-seed state-reuse design. Gemini 2.5 Flash state observation 65.5% control→95.4% with protocol guidance; repeating on Gemini 3.7 Flash produced the opposite effect and the proxy no longer reliably predicted completion.
assessments.uncertainty: One task family/intervention; exact reversal magnitude is not given in the clean state.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly binds evaluations to executor/model/configuration, limits claims to exact tested scope, and requires behavioral/outcome change rather than storage/verbal recall, so this principle is already known. No direct cross-generation replication is recorded.

assessments.mechanism: Treat correct evolving analytical state—inheritance, update, counterfactual perturbation, rollback and composition—as a separate long-horizon capability from raw step budget.
assessments.clean_scope: LongDS-Bench 2026: 68 tasks/2,225 turns/six domains, mean dependency span 11.3 turns; best model 48.45% average; nearly 47-point early-to-late decline; long-horizon errors 52%-69% of failures; extra agent steps not necessarily beneficial.
assessments.uncertainty: Headline benchmark evidence does not isolate a successful state-recovery mechanism.
assessments.o_comparison: O Context Kernel directly implements evolving authoritative source state, source clocks and invalidation, but end-to-end behavioral benefit is still under evaluation and LongDS patterns are not measured.
